# Rate Card (The Common: Battersea, Clapham, Nine Elms & Balham)

Prices ex VAT. Publish once the list passes 2,000 and opens are measured; before
that, founding packages only. Reprice at each tier; never mid-contract.

## Founding partners (pre-launch to 2,000 subscribers)
| Package | What | Price | Slots |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anchor partner | "Brought to you by" in masthead, Instagram bio, archive and launch print, for 12 months; one presenting slot a month | £1,500 (rises to £3,000 at 5k, £6,000 at 10k) | 1 (Battersea Power Station, a BID, or an estate-agency chain) |
| Founding partner | Logo line in every issue for 6 months, launch-issue feature, named in launch posts | £900 | 3 |
| Launch sponsor | Presenting slot in 6 issues within the first 90 days | £500 | 6 |

## Rules
- Max two paid native items per main issue, all labelled "Partner".
- No category exclusivity under £5k a year. Category blocklist: gambling, payday
  lending, unregulated health claims, party politics.
- Monday report to every active sponsor: delivered, unique clicks, CTR vs issue
  average, next available dates, renewal link.
- Card or invoice via Stripe, 14 days; founding packages up front.
- No single sponsor above 15 to 20% of revenue.
